attempts.sql: SELECT DISTINCT ce.caller_symbol_id AS passing_symbol_id, ce.callee_symbol_id AS passed_symbol_id FROM code.call_edges ce WHERE ce.passes_as_callback AND ce.caller_kind IN ('function','method') AND ce.callee_kind IN ('function','method') AND ce.caller_file_id LIKE 'src/click/%' AND ce.callee_file_id LIKE 'src/click/%' AND NOT ce.is_self_call

request:
Inside the bodies of functions and methods in the click library (src/click/), where is a module-level function or a method defined in the repository passed by reference as an argument to another call (so the receiving call is expected to invoke it) rather than being called at that point? Module-level code outside any function, and nested helper functions, do not count. Give the symbol ID of the function or method containing the call and the symbol ID of the function passed, one row per distinct pair.

Requested output columns: passing_symbol_id (string), passed_symbol_id (string).
explanation: Selects distinct caller/callee pairs from code.call_edges where the callee is passed as a callback reference, restricted to callers that are functions or methods (excluding class bodies and module-level code) and to symbols defined under src/click/. Self-references are excluded.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT ce.caller_symbol_id AS passing_symbol_id, ce.callee_symbol_id AS passed_symbol_id FROM code.call_edges ce WHERE ce.passes_as_callback AND ce.caller_kind IN ('function','method') AND ce.callee_kind IN ('function','method') AND ce.caller_file_id LIKE 'src/click/%' AND ce.callee_file_id LIKE 'src/click/%' AND NOT ce.is_self_call
